items.headline: Oil slides ~3% in Asia as Doha talks enter a third day — front-month Brent ~$109.77 (-3.2%), WTI ~$100.53 (-3.4%); Tehran floats a two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but tanker attacks keep the risk premium alive
Fitch cuts France's outlook to negative (Oct 30, unscheduled; A+ affirmed) — debt seen at ~124% of GDP by 2028, deficit 5.4% in 2026; euro languishes near a 17-month low at $1.1159 in early Asia

China RatingDog manufacturing PMI 52.0 in October — beats the 51.6 Reuters poll, in line with the 52.0 calendar forecast (prev 52.1); output growth fastest in six months but export-order growth slowed to a three-month low
Dollar rangebound into Tuesday's US midterms — DXY ~101.83 in Asia; the week's slate: RBA tonight 9:30pm CT, EZ flash CPI Wed 4:00am CT, BoE Thu 6:00am CT, US payrolls Fri 7:30am CT
RBA hike ~81% and BoE hike ~94.4% priced for this week (ActionForex Nov 2); JPMorgan joins the RBA hike camp, sees a tightening bias persisting
OPEC+ formally holds December output targets steady (Reuters Nov 1) — third straight hold at Sunday's online meeting; 2027 quotas due at the Nov 29 ministerial after a Q4 capacity review
China official PMIs miss in October — manufacturing back in contraction at 49.3 (vs 50.0 poll, prev 50.1), non-manufacturing 49.7

NY close (3:00 PM CT): EUR/USD 1.1169 (-0.11%), GBP/USD 1.3397 (+0.14%), USD/JPY 157.48 (-0.15%), USD/CHF 0.8236 (-0.31%), AUD/USD 0.7038 (+0.13%), USD/CAD 1.3948 (-0.34%), NZD/USD 0.5638 (+0.08%); DXY 101.63 (-0.40%); Brent $116.57, WTI $104.15; gold $3,882.50 (-3.4%, one-year low); US 10Y ~4.94%
